name: Double Backward Voxel Grid Feature
definition: A custom CUDA implementation for computing second-order gradients (gradients of gradients) for voxel grid features, necessary for Eikonal regularization, avoiding the memory overhead of automatic differentiation frameworks.
summary: A custom CUDA implementation that efficiently computes second-order gradients for voxel grid features to support Eikonal regularization, avoiding the memory overhead of naive automatic differentiation.
